notes.en:
- Fix: messages sent on Neonize disappearing from conversations (#937)

This release brings communities and a reorganized settings window, on top of everything in version 2.1.0.0.

WHAT'S NEW

- Sent messages: with the Neonize engine, messages you sent could disappear from the conversation when WinZapp was reopened, because no copy of them was stored. Each sent message is now stored as soon as its delivery is confirmed.
- WPPConnect, connecting with a QR code or a phone number: after the phone accepts the pairing, WinZapp no longer says the connection failed while WhatsApp Web is still opening the chats. The check made 4 minutes after pairing could not read the connection state on recent WhatsApp Web versions and reported a working connection as failed.

- WPPConnect: a browser named in the PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH environment variable, such as a native Chrome for Windows on ARM, is used again, and when more than one browser version is downloaded WinZapp uses the one WPPConnect asks for, not the first one it finds.

- Pinned messages: a chat's pinned messages button now opens the "Pinned messages" window, listing the pinned messages. Each one has the message list's context menu and shortcuts: copy, forward, react, star, unpin, delete, transcribe and the rest, with the keys you chose. Reply, edit and the other actions that take you into the chat close the window and run on the message, focused in the chat; Enter or "Go to message" takes you to it in the history.

- Selected messages: "Unpin selected", under "Bulk actions" in the context menu, unpins every selected message that is pinned at once. With "Replace shortcuts with bulk actions when selecting chats and messages" checked, Ctrl+Shift+P pins the selected messages, or unpins them when all of them are already pinned.

- New option in Settings > Accessibility > Spoken content: "Announce how many messages are pinned when a chat opens", checked by default. Unchecked, WinZapp no longer says "Pinned messages in this chat: N" when you open a chat.

- New option in Settings > General > Notifications: "Notify reactions to your messages", checked by default. Unchecked, a reaction to one of your messages is not spoken, plays no sound and does not appear in Windows notifications; it still shows on the message and in the chat list.

- Message text (Alt+C): the window has a new "Wrap long lines" box, checked by default. Unchecked, a line only ends where the message itself has a line break, whatever the length of the line or the size of the window. The choice is kept for next time, and copying still gives the text as it was written.

- Calls: a call you started on your phone that became a group call can be rejoined from WinZapp after you leave it: "Join ongoing voice call" appears in the chat of each person still in it, and its row in the Calls tab shows their names. Works with Neonize and WPPConnect.

- Neonize: joining a group call already under way, you now hear the people whose phones send audio in a format WinZapp used to drop; with them, you heard nobody.

- Neonize group calls: each person's audio now has its own NetEQ playback, as in one-to-one calls, which smooths network jitter and audio loss for each of them separately; before, the whole group was mixed without it, with more gaps and delay. Live translation and devices not supported by NetEQ keep compatible playback.

- Neonize calls: when an audio packet is lost and the next one carries a copy of it, as some phones send, WinZapp now plays that copy instead of filling the gap with an estimate.

- Save As (Ctrl+Shift+S) on a JSON document received in a chat, such as the settings file app.json, now saves the file instead of saying it could not be downloaded.

- Shortcuts: switching to another account right after changing a key, the account that comes up answers to the new key even while the previous one is still saving its settings; before, it could stay on the old key until it saved something.

- Reconnecting after a long time offline: WinZapp now receives the accumulated messages, reactions and read receipts without freezing the interface on every database write, and the Neonize engine writes its database faster.
- macOS: choosing another connection engine in the pairing window now restarts WinZapp on it. It used to say that WinZapp could not restart by itself, and the engine was not changed.
- History of unknown groups: WinZapp no longer freezes its interface when it recovers old messages of a group it did not know yet. It used to look up the group's name on the interface thread, and each lookup could take up to 10 seconds during which WinZapp did not respond. The name is now looked up in the background and appears as soon as it arrives.
- When the playback or recording device chosen in Settings, such as headphones, is not connected as WinZapp starts, WinZapp now says so once and uses the system default device, instead of showing a message box at every launch. The box held up startup until it was answered, so a launch with no one at the computer ended in an error saying the WinZapp API had failed to start in time, and the program closed. The chosen device is kept and used again once it is connected.

- macOS: WinZapp's check for newer WhatsApp Web versions now works on Macs without Python from python.org installed. It used to fail with a certificate error that the log reported as "offline", so the list of versions never updated and, once WhatsApp stopped serving the build WinZapp was using, WPPConnect could no longer connect.

- Neonize engine: in the pairing window and in Settings, the Neonize label no longer says "experimental" and now says "default".

- Neonize calls: fixed compatible audio fallback when exclusive output uses a rate unsupported by NetEQ, preserving packet-loss concealment.

- One-to-one Neonize calls: NetEQ playback smooths network jitter and audio loss, with automatic fallback to compatible playback.

- Neonize calls: audio uses a direct local connection to the native engine, with automatic Socket.IO fallback when unavailable.

- One-to-one Neonize calls: removed a duplicate wait in incoming audio while keeping automatic playback buffering that protects against network jitter.

- Neonize calls: microphone audio conversion is optimized to reduce Python processing, with automatic fallback when the installed engine does not support the optimization.

- Czech: WinZapp is now available in Czech (Čeština): the interface, the user guide, the installer and uninstaller (which follow the Windows display language) and these release notes. Czech is also offered as a language to translate messages into, and the spell checker supports it. Thanks to jaxcze for the translation.

- Connect with QR code: the QR code shows up again. With the latest WhatsApp Web versions, some computers get a separate login page that only has the QR code screen, and on it WinZapp kept connecting until it gave up, without showing the code. The QR code now shows up on that page within a few seconds.

- Logged out when WinZapp starts: with the latest WhatsApp Web versions, WinZapp opened WhatsApp Web's separate login page even for an account that was already linked, so the account came back logged out, showing a QR code, every time WinZapp started, and a device just linked with the QR code or the phone number was dropped again a few seconds later. WinZapp no longer opens that page for a linked account: WhatsApp Web opens your chats as usual, and the login page is only used to link.

- Restoring the saved copy of the browser profile: when WhatsApp Web opened logged out and WinZapp restored the last saved copy, the restore could fail if the previous browser had not finished closing, and WinZapp was left on an empty profile that only offered a QR code. WinZapp now waits for that browser to close before restoring and does not restore while it is still open; if a restore fails anyway, the profile it had is put back, so the saved copy can still be restored on the next attempt.

- Communities: Enter on a community in the chat list now opens the Communities panel with that community selected and the focus on its groups, instead of the community's own chat. Settings > Interface > Chats has the option, on by default.

- Linking by phone number: the link no longer fails after WhatsApp on the phone accepts the pairing code. WinZapp used to close WhatsApp Web during the reload that finishes the login, or ask for a new code on it, so the phone showed the device as linked while WinZapp stayed on the pairing window. The pairing code window also lists its text, the code and Cancel in order instead of drawing them on top of each other. If WhatsApp Web still does not open your chats after the code is accepted, WinZapp now tries once more and then tells you, instead of waiting on the pairing window forever, and a link the phone accepted is no longer discarded when you restart WinZapp. Linking with the QR code now survives that reload too: WinZapp no longer shows a new QR code and gives up a few seconds after the phone accepted the scan.

- When WhatsApp temporarily refuses pairing codes for a number, WinZapp says so right away instead of staying on "connecting" for a minute and a half, and suggests "Connect with QR code", which does not use a pairing code.

- Copying just the caption of a message (Ctrl+Shift+C) now makes the screen reader say "Caption copied" instead of "Message copied", so it no longer sounds as if the file (photo, video or document) was copied.

- The contact name on the quoted message of a reply now follows their most recent profile name instead of showing an old one, even when their original messages were already up to date. Applies to Neonize and WPPConnect.

- Copying the selected messages (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+C, or Ctrl+C with "Replace shortcuts with bulk actions when selecting chats and messages" checked) now also copies documents, audio, images and videos: the files go to the clipboard at once and can be pasted together, for example in File Explorer, under their original names. In a selection that mixes text and files, the text comes along as a single block to paste into a text field. WinZapp says "Messages copied" and, if a file could not be downloaded, how many were left out.

- Reactions: a custom reaction chosen with "Add more reactions" now joins the quick reactions list the first time it is used, in place of the last default reaction you have never used. There are also ten new commands in Settings > Keyboard shortcuts (Messages), "React to the selected message with the reaction in this position", 1 to 9 and 0 for the tenth: each reacts to the focused message with the reaction in that position of Settings > Interface > Reactions, which you choose and which does not change with usage; pressing the reaction already sent removes it. They come without a key, because Ctrl+Alt+1 to 9 already switch accounts; you pick the key for each.

- Updates: the update window gains "Additional settings" (Alt+A), after Yes, No and What's new?. It opens a window where you choose, for the installation, between "All WinZapp sounds" and "Only the original WhatsApp sounds", with the current choice stated, plus OK and Cancel. The choice is applied when the update is installed, also when it installs in the background or on exit: choosing only the original WhatsApp sounds removes the extra WinZapp sounds, and choosing all of them again restores them from the update. Sound packs you imported, your own sound files and your sound preferences are kept.

- Voice messages and audio can now be saved as MP3 using the file type list in Save As.

- Individual calls can be translated with Gemini Live Translate in one or both directions, with optional volume reduction for the original voice and automatic reconnection.
- New option in Settings > Accessibility: "Announce even when WinZapp is not focused", unchecked by default. Unchecked, WinZapp speaks through the screen reader only while one of its windows has focus, so it does not interrupt you while you work in another program, even with the window open; this covers every spoken announcement, the new-version notice included. Checked, announcements continue in every situation.

- When a contact changes their profile name, their older messages in the open conversation are now updated at once with the new name, without closing and reopening the program. Applies to Neonize and WPPConnect.

- Call links: in Calls (Alt+6), "Create call link" opens a window where you choose a voice or video call, create the link, copy it, send it to a chat or join its call. A call.whatsapp.com link in a message joins its call with Enter, or with "Join call" in its context menu, after a confirmation; a link opened in a browser also joins in WinZapp when WinZapp is the program set to open WhatsApp links (Settings > General). Whoever joins a link first is the call's admin: people without a WhatsApp account wait in a waiting room, WinZapp says the name of each one who arrives, and the call window's "Waiting room" button lets them in or denies them. It works with Neonize and WPPConnect.

- Contacts: the navigation list gains "Contacts" after Channels, with no Alt+number shortcut. It shows the saved contacts, one row per person by name and number; a contact kept under two addresses (its number and its linked ID, or a Brazilian number with and without the 9th digit) is a single row. "Search contacts" filters by name or number. Buttons and the context menu (Applications key or Shift+F10) open the conversation, start a voice or video call, show "Contact details", delete the contact, or block or unblock it; "New contact" adds one. "Enter on a contact" chooses what Enter does: open the conversation, call, video call or show the details.

- Conversation: the Chat info and Group info windows get a new "Starred messages" tab after "Media", listing the starred messages of that chat with a search field; "Open in the conversation" (or Enter) focuses the message in the conversation, and "Remove star" (or Delete) removes its star.

- Calls: a chat that is in an ongoing call, a group or a private chat whose call grew to several people, now shows "Join ongoing voice call" or "Join ongoing video call (camera off)" instead of the call buttons; while this device is in the call with that chat, the button reads "Return to call" and brings the call window back.

- Calls: a one-to-one call that became a group call is listed by its people, as on the phone ("A, B and C", or "A and N more people"), in the chat, the chat list preview and the Calls tab. A group call that went on without you, where your device only rang, is no longer shown as answered.

- Calls, "Add participants": each person appears once, so a contact saved with and without the 9th digit, or under its number and its linked ID, is a single row; a second list offers every one-to-one conversation, saved contact or not; and a field takes a phone number typed by hand.

- Calls: when you add people, WinZapp says "Calling <names>..." while the invitation is out and "Invited to the call" only after WhatsApp's server confirmed it, instead of announcing people who never rang. Neonize: adding someone to a one-to-one call, or to a call that is already a group call, now rings them without silencing the person already in the call; and someone the roster names by number in one answer and by linked ID in the next is no longer announced as leaving and joining.

- Calls: when the NVDA process that desktop audio sharing follows closes while the call goes on, the share starts again once by itself, as pressing "Share desktop audio" again would; a restart that fails is announced as before.

- Neonize: a one-to-one call you place from WinZapp now also appears in your phone's call history.

- Message translation: besides your online AI providers, "Provider" in the translation settings offers "Offline model on this computer" (twelve models, SMaLL-100, M2M-100, mBART-50, NLLB-200 and MADLAD-400 in several sizes, downloaded with "Download model" and run on the processor or the graphics card; the text never leaves the computer, so there is no consent question and no daily limit), the translation services LibreTranslate, DeepL, Google Cloud Translation, Microsoft Translator (with its resource region) and Google Translate, and Ollama and LM Studio as local providers. For the offline model, the source language is detected or chosen.

- Installer: a new "Sounds to install" group chooses between "All of WinZapp's sounds" (the default) and "Only the original WhatsApp sounds". With the second, the other sounds are not kept in the installation, and updates keep leaving them out.

- Portable version: on its first start, when the WinZapp installed on the computer has paired accounts, WinZapp asks whether to use a copy of them instead of linking one more device. The installation is only read; if it is running, WinZapp asks you to close it and choose Retry, and if the copy fails nothing is changed and a new device is linked.

- Settings > Shortcuts: the keys you change now apply to every account of the installation, not only the one where you changed them; a key set for switch to account 2 answers from every account. On the first start with this version, each account's changed keys join the installation's: where both changed a command the installation's key stays, and a key that another command already uses is left out. You can also keep keys for one account only: the "Use the same shortcuts in every account" box on the same page comes checked; unchecked, the keys you change in this account apply to it alone, and the other accounts keep theirs. Each shortcut's Change window also has a "Use this shortcut in every account" box, which follows the general one until you change it; a shortcut that does not follow the general box shows "every account" or "this account only" in the list.

- Edited messages: Sound events gains "Edit of your message saved" (on) and "Message edited by someone else" for the program in the foreground and in the background (off); Settings > General > Notifications gains "Speak edits while the window is active" and "Notify edits while in the background" (off); and each conversation's data window has an "Edited messages" window to choose different sounds and announcements for that chat. Someone else's edit is announced only while WhatsApp still accepts an edit of that message, so edits replayed after a reconnection stay silent.

- Sounds and calls set to "system default" now follow Windows' default playback device: when you plug in a headset that Windows makes the default, WinZapp's sounds and the call audio move to it, as other programs do.

- While you record audio (a voice message or microphone plus computer audio), the recurring background sync, the history walk and the media downloads pause, as they already did during a call, so the recording is not cut into pieces by a busy computer.

- A deleted conversation comes back to the list when it is used again, by a new message or by reopening it from New chat, even when it was deleted under another form of the person, such as the linked ID or the number with or without the 9th digit.

- WPPConnect: a message that a reply quotes no longer jumps to the end of its chat after WinZapp restarts; it keeps its real time.

- WPPConnect, New chat: a Brazilian number typed with the 9th digit that WhatsApp does not use now opens the real conversation instead of a second, empty one.

- Neonize: while the phone sends the message history, WinZapp says so and asks you to keep WhatsApp open on the phone's screen, warns when the phone stops (with the percentage), when it sends again and when it finishes; while it is stopped, WinZapp asks the phone for the rest every 90 seconds.

- Neonize: the conversations that WhatsApp for iPhone leaves out of its first history batch (it now sends only 400) are now requested and imported as well. When the phone does not send the list of the ones left out, WinZapp, once the pairing's history is done, asks the phone for the conversations that are missing and waits a few minutes for the answer before calling the sync complete.

- Neonize: deleting a list also removes it from its chats, so they do not keep pointing at a list that no longer exists.

- Noise reducer settings: the model field now has an Alt letter in every language.

- The microphone + computer audio recording now goes out as a voice message (Ctrl+Shift+H), not as an audio attachment; it keeps stereo (AAC) when both channels carry sound, like other stereo recordings. Before, it was sent as an ordinary audio file in the chat.

- Neonize: messages received while WinZapp is open now show as delivered to the sender, even with the window unfocused or in the background. Before, the sender only ever saw "sent" while WinZapp was unfocused; and with read receipts off, opening the conversation changed nothing. The online presence stays bound to the window.

- Neonize: a message you sent could flip back to "Sent" after WhatsApp had already confirmed it as delivered — in the messages list and the status line. The app no longer overwrites a real delivery, read or played confirmation with its own "sent" ack, and no message status moves backwards once confirmed.

- While NVDA is running, recording the microphone together with the computer's audio no longer stops with "audio device problem" when WinZapp stalls for a second or two (a busy or slow computer): the audio from that moment is skipped, the recording goes on, and the rest stays in sync. This already held without separate NVDA capture; the separately recorded NVDA and other computer sound readers are covered now too.

- Voice messages can use neural noise reduction in the background while recording, instead of waiting until send time. The noise reducer settings window in Settings > Audio lets you choose basic or neural reduction, processing while recording or when sending (the default), and what to do if neural reduction fails: send with basic reduction or keep the message pending for a manual retry. Recording-time processing uses the CPU or CoreML; selecting CUDA disables it and uses processing at send time. There is no CUDA processing while recording. The CoreML recording path has not been validated in real use.

- A contact now has a single name: when someone changes their profile name, all their messages, old ones and group ones included, show the new name instead of switching between the old and the new. Applies to Neonize and WPPConnect.

- Startup: speech support now uses its own temporary COM cache, preventing circular-import errors when the shared Windows cache has lost its index.

- The buttons of a business message now also show when the conversation opens with the message already focused, such as a conversation with a single message, not only after moving focus to it. This works with Neonize and WPPConnect.

- In the online AI provider list and in the options of a new poll, Alt+Up Arrow and Alt+Down Arrow move the selected item, and the Move up and Move down buttons announce those keys. The keys appear in the F1 list and can be changed in Settings > Shortcuts.

- When creating a poll, the Hide voter names checkbox and the Time limit choice (no limit, 1 hour, 8 hours, 24 hours, 3 days or 7 days) now work with both Neonize and WPPConnect. In View votes, a poll that hides names shows "Hidden name" in place of who voted; your own vote still reads "You".
- When creating a poll, the Move up and Move down buttons reorder the options before sending; the poll goes to WhatsApp in the order you left it, with both Neonize and WPPConnect.

- Starred messages now end with the word "Starred", like "Edited" and "Forwarded", instead of starting with the ★ symbol. A new option in Settings > User interface > Messages announces the word at the start of the line, before the sender.

- The default sound pack's typing, typing_bubble, typing_pulse and AI processing sounds are now Ogg files, like the rest of the pack. Nothing changes in how they sound or in your custom sounds.

- Inside an open chat with the message search (Ctrl+Shift+F) active, the first Esc clears the search and closes the bar, and the screen reader says "Message search cleared"; the next Esc closes the chat. You can turn it off in Settings, Chats.

- In the chat lists (regular, archived and locked), Esc clears the search and the filters and the screen reader says "Filters cleared"; with chats selected, the first Esc still deselects just the selection. You can turn it off in Settings, Chats. This also works from the filters, the search and the other controls of the chat panel; inside an open chat, Esc still closes the chat or deselects the messages first.

- Adding a chat to a list or removing it from one on another device updates the lists and the open filter, without changing the list you selected.

- Changing your profile photo on another device updates the open Profile panel, without replacing a name, About or photo you have not saved yet.

- Changing Keep chats archived or Status privacy on another device updates the open panel, keeping the choices you have not applied yet.

- Fixed saved contacts missing from WhatsApp on iPhone: the linked-device contact ID is now sent in full, matching WhatsApp's native contact screen.

- Saving a contact to the phone now says that the phone was asked to add it, instead of saying it is already in the address book; a save WhatsApp did not confirm is no longer reported as done.

- Privacy changes made on another device update the open panel, keeping the fields you have changed but not applied yet.

- Blocking or unblocking a contact on another device updates WinZapp as soon as WhatsApp reports it.

- When a contact or group changes or removes its picture, WinZapp stops showing the old one.

- Contacts saved, renamed or removed from the address book on another device, and public profile-name changes, update WinZapp when notified while preserving local names and history.

- Group descriptions, settings and participants now follow live notices, including admin promotion and demotion, and refresh sending permissions in the open chat.

- Deleting a chat on another device removes it from WinZapp when the notice arrives; a chat with messages newer than the notice is kept. If it was open, it is closed and WinZapp says why.

- Pinning or unpinning a message on another device updates its flag and the open chat’s pinned-message overview when the notice arrives.

- Changing the disappearing-messages timer on another device, in a chat or a group, updates WinZapp without waiting for a full sync.

- Locking or unlocking a chat on your phone updates WinZapp when the notice arrives; if it was open, it is closed and WinZapp says why.

- Mute, archive and pin changes made on another device update the chat list when the notice arrives, with WPPConnect and Neonize.

- Messages deleted for you on another device are removed from the conversation when the deletion notice arrives, with WPPConnect and Neonize.

- Starring or unstarring a message on the phone or another device updates its mark in the open conversation when the notice arrives, with WPPConnect and Neonize.

- Neonize: edits preserve the original message ID and record the complete edit-notice key, including the author in groups.

- Neonize: reaction events use the WPPConnect format, with complete keys for the reaction and original message, the sender and a timestamp in seconds.

- In the open conversation, poll results refresh when a new vote event arrives, with both Neonize and WPPConnect. Neonize: WPPConnect-compatible events for votes, revoked messages and label associations; received status IDs preserve the author.

- Archiving a chat now asks for confirmation, from the context menu or with Ctrl+Shift+Q, like deleting does. The dialog asks "Are you sure you want to archive this chat?" and has the buttons "Archive chat" (Alt+A) and "Cancel" (Alt+C), plus a "Don't show again" box that only counts together with the confirmation. In Settings > User Interface, the option "Ask for confirmation before archiving chats" turns the question back on.

- Translating the messages already in a chat: the message context menu gains "Translate from here to the end" (Alt+Shift+Y) and the bulk action "Translate the selected messages" shows its shortcut, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Y. Both can be changed in the Shortcuts tab of Settings, and the menu items show the shortcut in use. While a translation of several messages runs, the same menu item and shortcut become "Cancel translating the messages". It covers received text messages, up to 50 at a time, with the provider, model and display of "Translate message".

- Writing help: WinZapp gains a feature similar to writing help in WhatsApp for mobile, with the added option of translating the draft. The new button after Emoji and the composer context menu open the same window. Correct, rephrase, use a professional or encouraging tone with the AI providers configured in WinZapp, not Meta AI; translation uses Google. Consent is requested before sending the draft and the result is previewed before replacement; the message is never sent automatically. Choose an action, then press "Run selected action". Opening or closing this window does not send the draft.

- Writing help: new Alt+Shift+H shortcut to open the window from anywhere in the chat while a draft is written. It can be changed in the Shortcuts tab of Settings, and the field's context menu and the button now show the shortcut in use.

- WPPConnect Server updated to 2.10.87, with WPPConnect 2.4.6 and WA-JS 4.8.2, which makes sending messages work again after WhatsApp Web changed internally. Reading message history no longer piles up copies in memory, the browser WinZapp drives is closed automatically only when WinZapp itself opened it, and waiting for WhatsApp Web to load now also works while the page is hidden. Media received without a download address is now downloaded by the message ID.

- AI message summary, as in WhatsApp: the open conversation gains a "Summarize unread messages" button and the Ctrl+Shift+U shortcut; the context menu of the conversations list gains "Summarize unread messages with AI", which reads the messages from the database without opening the chat or marking it as read; and a message's context menu offers summarizing the unread ones, "from here to the end" and the selected ones. The button only appears with 10 or more unread messages; the shortcut works with any number. The summary uses the AI providers already set up in Settings > Online AI (not Meta AI), opens in a window with follow-up questions and a Copy button, and says it was made by AI and may contain errors. Voice messages go in as text: WinZapp uses the transcription already saved or transcribes on the spot with local transcription, the 20 most recent ones, in a window that shows the progress and has a Cancel button; without transcription set up they stay a marker and the result says so. Consent is its own, asked before any voice message is transcribed, once, and remembered in ordinary chats; in locked chats it is asked every time, never remembered, and the window closes when the vault locks. The summary covers up to 200 messages and 15,000 characters and says how many older messages were left out.

- AI summary: two new shortcuts for the message context menu, Alt+Shift+I to summarize from here to the end and Ctrl+Alt+Shift+I to summarize the selected messages. They can be changed in the Shortcuts tab of Settings, and the menu items now show the shortcut in use, including Ctrl+Shift+U on the unread one.

- AI summary: when you summarize messages that include voice messages without a saved transcription, a window asks how to transcribe them: locally (the default), online with a provider and a transcription model separate from the summary's model, or not at all. Before the voice messages are sent, a question says how many go, to which provider, and that this may use quota or incur charges, with a box to remember that provider's consent. Saved transcriptions are reused, and the result warns how many voice messages failed or were left out by the limit. Opening, changing or closing the windows sends nothing. Requested by UlisesMilani (#791).

- WPPConnect: when disk space runs low (less than 4 GB free), WinZapp closes WhatsApp safely before it loses the session, goes offline and says why. Once at least 5 GB are free it connects again by itself. Before, with about 3 GB free, the session could come back logged out as if it had been wiped.

- Automatic transcription: a voice message received while the computer was asleep is no longer left untranscribed when it arrives together with others on waking.

- Neonize: someone joining a group by its invite link shows as "joined using the group's invite link", as on WhatsApp Web, and joining a group by link yourself also leaves that notice in the chat.

- Clearing a chat on the phone now clears the same chat in WinZapp, on both connection engines. Starred messages stay when the phone kept them, and a message that arrived after the clear is not removed.

- Channels: a channel opened from the Channels window, for example from the Trending or Recommended lists, loads its updates right away instead of showing "No updates in this channel yet." until the next sync. The details of a channel you do not follow are read too.

- Groups: the "Group info" button keeps up with the number of participants. In a group you just joined whose participant list takes a while to arrive, the number appears as soon as the list arrives, and it changes when someone joins or leaves while the chat is open.

- After the computer resumes from sleep, WinZapp no longer shows "Updating chats" again a few minutes later. Chats that could not be read while the connection was coming back are read in the same sync.

- Neonize: changing a WhatsApp privacy option, such as "Last seen" or "Read receipts", no longer shows "Some settings could not be applied." when WhatsApp applied the change.

- The account log no longer records the WPPConnect session's access code when media is downloaded.

- Connection engine: Neonize is now first in the list and the option already selected when WinZapp asks for the engine on the first launch; it is still marked as experimental, but it is the one recommended for general use. WPPConnect becomes the second option, marked "alternative" after its name, on the first launch, in the pairing window and in Settings > Connection. Anyone already using WPPConnect stays on it until they switch.
- After a long time without opening WinZapp: while WhatsApp is still delivering old messages after the sync, the window title keeps saying "Updating chats" instead of presenting everything as synced, and the chat list stays still, so you can move through it without chats changing place. It is updated once when the messages stop arriving. This applies to both Neonize and WPPConnect. On Neonize, WinZapp also uses WhatsApp's own notice that old messages are waiting to be delivered, so the status shows from the first message and only goes away when the delivery ends.

- Notifications: when many new messages arrive at once (for example, after an unstable connection comes back), WinZapp plays and speaks only the first three and stays quiet until the burst ends, instead of repeating the sound dozens of times. The messages are still in the list and count as unread. The limit is chosen in Settings > General > Notifications, under "Maximum notifications per second when many messages arrive at once" (default: 3).

- Neonize: accepting the Meta AI terms no longer fails with a WhatsApp error. WinZapp now sends the acceptance in the same format WhatsApp Web uses for this notice and only confirms it after reading again that the notice is recorded as accepted.

- Calls: better support for stereo microphones and headphones in shared mode, with mono fallback when needed. Voice is still sent in mono.

- In the call window, press Ctrl+M from any control to mute or unmute the microphone and hear its new state. The outgoing call window shows the call status and announces when it rings or connects.

- During a voice call on Windows 11, use Share desktop audio to send the system sound or the sound of a single application, with or without NVDA audio, at the volume you choose. Nothing is selected at first. Muting the microphone does not stop the share, and changing the call's audio devices keeps it going. Use Stop sharing desktop audio to end sharing independently of the microphone.

- Neonize: in calls, the other person's voice is buffered a little longer (about 60 ms) to reduce breakups when audio arrives in bursts.

- Message translation: press Shift+Enter on a text message in the message list (the shortcut can be changed), or use its context menu. Set it up in Settings > Online AI: Transcriptions and Descriptions > Message translation: the provider (your AI providers, Grok, or your own OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible address), the model, the target language, and whether the translation replaces the text, follows it or opens in a separate window. Optional automatic translation of received messages, in all chats or only the ones you turn on, with a maximum message age and a daily limit; it pauses for an hour if the provider refuses the key, quota or credit. Locked chats are never translated automatically, and translating a message from one asks for confirmation every time. The kinds of media that online AI handles are now in the "Types of media handled..." window, on the same page. Turning automatic translation on for a chat now also translates its 10 latest received messages, however old, and "Translate the selected messages", in the bulk actions, translates the selected text messages (up to 50) after asking for confirmation. Requested by UlisesMilani (#793).

- Neonize: a notice that a message was deleted, for a message or chat WinZapp does not have, no longer creates an "Unnamed group" in the chat list. Deleted messages in your existing chats are unchanged.

- Neonize: old media that the phone re-uploads after the request to send it again is now actually downloaded. Before, the re-uploaded file was refused because it did not match the check of the original file and the media still would not open.

- Update on exit: a new option in Settings > General downloads updates automatically, without asking, and installs them when you exit WinZapp. Closing the window to the tray does not count as exiting, and WinZapp does not open again after the installation: it stays closed and uses the new version the next time you open it.

- Neonize: old chat history is now really imported during the background sync; the previous fix was still undone at the end of each sweep. Old media that cannot be recovered even after asking the phone now shows as expired instead of a repeated connection error.

- Neonize: media whose link expired is now requested again from the phone. When a download fails because the link expired, WinZapp asks the phone to upload the media again and downloads it from the new link; if the phone no longer has the file, the media stays marked as expired.

- New replies and sent messages no longer appear above the original message when the computer's clock is behind WhatsApp's. The provisional time of a sent message is never earlier than the last message already shown or the message being replied to.

- Neonize: history that the phone sends over several hours is no longer declared complete by a 45-second pause between blocks. While the reported progress is below 100%, WinZapp waits up to 10 minutes of silence, so chats are not treated as final too early.

- Media that fails to download: the error message no longer mentions WPPConnect, which does not exist on the Neonize engine. It now says the link may have expired or the WhatsApp connection may be unavailable.

- Business templates: preserve available text and supported buttons, keep button positions, and explain missing content or unsupported actions. Empty old records cannot be reconstructed.

- WPPConnect Server 2.10.79 is now offered as an update without waiting for a new WinZapp version. It only updates security dependencies, and WinZapp's changes to the server are not affected.

- Neonize: after pairing with "All the history", old chat history is now really imported. Before, hundreds of old, empty chats you never opened stalled the import, and most of the messages already downloaded never showed up. Old media whose link has expired is now recognised as expired instead of failing with an error and being retried several times.

- Mentions: in a group message with @all, Tab no longer goes through one link per member right after the chat opens. Before, this happened until the group's members finished loading and the message lost focus.

- Local transcription: switching accounts while voice notes are transcribed no longer fills the computer's memory. One model is loaded at a time: a second transcription, of the same account or another, waits for the first and says it is waiting, and an account's idle model is released when another one needs the card.

- Clear chat (Neonize): clearing a chat in WinZapp now clears it on the phone too. The notice used to miss the phone, and the messages came back at the next sync.

- Automatic transcription: voice notes that arrive all at once after the computer hibernated or was offline are now transcribed. The time the computer slept or was offline no longer counts as a message's age, and the queue holds up to 100 messages.

- Local transcription: a new option, "Also transcribe the ones that arrive late", shown with automatic transcription on, transcribes received messages however long ago they were sent.

- Disappearing messages (Neonize): audio recorded with Ctrl+Shift+H, photos, videos and documents now follow the chat's disappearing messages timer.

- Calls (Neonize): a call you place to a contact no longer shows up in your own chat, as if you had called yourself.

- Group messages (Neonize): a message this computer could not open is now asked of your phone too, as WhatsApp Web does. It used to be lost when the sender's device did not send it again.

- Pairing (Neonize): when connecting, you choose how much history to bring: recent messages only, 30 days, 6 months, 1 year, all the history or a custom period in days, months or years. Messages older than about a year only arrive this way.

- Older messages (Neonize): the Home key goes on asking the phone for older messages until it has nothing more, even where WhatsApp Web stops.

- Channels: invitations to follow a channel or to be one of its admins now show in the chat, with the channel's name and the inviter's words. Enter opens the channel.

- Noise reducer: a new "Noise reducer settings" window in Settings, Audio, with the neural model and the processor it runs on: the computer's, an NVIDIA card with CUDA 12 (which uses the local transcription's components) or with CUDA 13, or Core ML on a Mac. Only the missing components are downloaded, following the option to download in the background, and they can be removed there. A new box chooses between the neural reducer and the common one, which is faster.

- Local transcription (whisper.cpp): on Windows ARM64 computers WinZapp uses the native ARM64 build and offers, as an option, the build for NVIDIA cards with CUDA 13.

- Channels: where WhatsApp offers it to your account, "Edit channel..." has "Show admin profile on updates", as in WhatsApp Web (WPPConnect).

- Channels: "Insights..." in the Channels window reads the statistics of a channel you administer, as WhatsApp Web shows them (reach, followers, net followers, new followers and unfollows over 30 days, by followers and others and by country), on WPPConnect and Neonize. WhatsApp has them from 100 followers on.

- Media downloads: "Downloading media: X of Y" now counts only the media still to download. It used to count the ones downloaded in earlier sessions too, and it looked as if almost nothing had come down (for example "723 of 728 processed (66 downloaded)", when the other 659 were already on the computer).

- Channels: in "Create channel..." and "Edit channel...", Reactions sets who may react to the updates (any emoji, default emojis only or no reactions), as in WhatsApp Web, on WPPConnect and Neonize.

- Starred messages: a new window lists every starred message of every chat (Alt+0, or the "Starred messages" row of the navigation list), with a search field; Enter opens the chat on the message, and Delete removes the star. Suggested in issue #708.

- Settings > User Interface > Chats: new option "Automatically focused position in the messages list". With "Continue where you left off (last focused message)", going back to a chat (including switching from one chat to another) puts the messages list on the message you were on when you left, whether or not new unread messages arrived. The unread separator and other rows that are not messages never count as a position. The default is still "Unread separator or last message". The option only chooses the message in the list: whether focus goes to the list or to the message field is still decided by the existing option.

- Bookmarks: two new checkboxes in Settings > User Interface > Chats, "Remove permanent bookmarks automatically after the first use" and "Remove temporary bookmarks automatically after the first use". When checked, jumping to a bookmark (Ctrl+0 to 9 for permanent ones, Alt+Shift+0 to 9 for temporary ones) removes it right away, so the same key sets a new bookmark next time, without removing it with Ctrl+Shift+number.

- Sounds: two new options in Settings, Sounds let you choose which sound plays for a new message while WinZapp is in the foreground, one for the open conversation and one for the other conversations. Each can keep the dedicated foreground sound, as before, or use the same notification sound you chose for messages in the background.

- WhatsApp links: WinZapp now opens chat links. A wa.me or api.whatsapp.com link (for example from an airline, a shop or a website) opens the chat with that number, even if it is not in your contacts, puts the message from the link in the message field and leaves the focus there, ready for you to review and send. Links with only a number work too. The installed version now registers itself for WhatsApp links on its first launch, so WinZapp appears under Default apps in Windows; the portable version keeps the option in Settings, General.

- Account manager: new check box "Connect all accounts when WinZapp starts". When it is on, starting WinZapp also opens every other paired account in the background.

- Backup: the profile backup (in Settings > Storage and the storage manager) is no longer shown when WinZapp runs with the Neonize engine, which has no browser profile to back up.

- Messages: conflicting alternate identities no longer route messages sent to or received from another person into your self-chat. Invalid aliases are ignored; unresolved messages stay with their original chat until the identity is resolved.

- Unread filter: after updating or restarting the program, some conversations with unread messages disappeared from the filter (for example, 12 became 9) until you resynced with F5. The count now looks at the conversation's newest messages instead of its oldest. Group conversations whose latest entries were group notices (invites, members added, a description change) no longer vanish either: those notices no longer take the place of the real unread messages.

- Alt+letter shortcuts: in several windows two controls used the same letter, so Alt+letter only moved between them (in some languages, for example, "Refresh" and "Add participants" in the call participants window). Each control in a window now has its own letter, in every language.

- Chat list: when the chosen filter (Unread, Groups, Individual), a WhatsApp list or the search finds no chat, the list shows one row saying so (for example "No unread chats."), as the message list already did for an empty chat, instead of leaving the screen reader nothing to read.

- Group calls: WinZapp now says who joins and who leaves the call (Settings > Calls, "Announce when someone joins a call" and "Announce when someone leaves a call", on by default), and the "Call participants" window updates by itself when it happens, with no Refresh button; F5 reads the list again.

- Global hotkey: with a WinZapp window waiting for an answer, such as the update prompt left open while the program was in the tray, the global hotkey now brings that window to the front. The main window used to come up and answer nothing.

- AI image descriptions: when the provider's account runs out of credit (OpenRouter answers 402), WinZapp now says so and suggests adding credits or choosing a free model, instead of asking to check the model identifier; with several providers it moves on to the next one.

- Recording with computer audio: on slower computers, recording the microphone together with the computer's audio (Ctrl+Shift+H) skipped and stuttered, worst with NVDA's speech recorded separately, because mixing the sounds could not keep up and pieces of audio were lost. The mixing is now many times faster and the recording comes out whole.

- Channels: on WPPConnect, posting to a channel you administer (text, photo, video or poll) failed before reaching WhatsApp, and an open channel showed only what WhatsApp Web already held, often no updates at all (The New York Times, for example) and none of your own new posts. Posts now go out, and a channel opens on a whole page of its newest updates, read from WhatsApp's server. Coming back from a channel with Esc, the Channels window is as you left it: the same list, search, category and selected channel.

- Updates: on a busy computer an update could stop with "WinZapp could not verify that it is safe to install the update. Installation was not started.", because the PowerShell that guards the install took more than 15 seconds to start; it now gets up to a minute. With Neonize, an update could also stop halfway, the bridge still closing in the background and holding its file: the installer now waits for it to close, and closes it if needed, before copying the files.

- Channels with Neonize: opening or syncing a channel asked WhatsApp for a thousand updates at once; the server did not answer, the channel stayed empty and the sync tried again every 30 seconds. Updates are now asked 100 at a time, as WhatsApp Web does.

- Message list: on a Brazilian (ABNT2) keyboard, pressing "/" in the message list wrote "Á" into the message field, and "ç" came out as "º". Typing in the list now sends the field the letter or digit the keyboard really types, and punctuation stays in the list. For the same reason, the "ÿ" that NVDA gestures with the Windows key left in the field came from a key NVDA itself injects; only that key is ignored now, and a real "ÿ" can be typed.

- Calls: the "Add participants" window now works with a screen reader. People are marked with the same keys, sound and announcements as in the conversation and message lists (Ctrl+Space, Space while something is marked, Shift+arrows, Ctrl+Shift+Space, Esc), and the result is spoken: who was invited, who could not be added, or why the request failed.

- Calls: delayed media and device/camera work stay with their original call and stream. Neonize processes media in bounded queues off the server loop and keeps its reader after a transient emission failure. Ambiguous WASAPI names no longer select the first matching device. Neonize call logs also include signal-level summaries without saving audio content, to help investigate silence. When call output is reopened, an old stream that fails to close cannot consume the new stream's audio; an echo-reference failure no longer silences rendered audio.

- Media tab of chats and groups: Ctrl+C on a document, photo, video or audio now copies the file to the clipboard, as in the message list, instead of saying "Could not copy this message." The context menu item is now "Copy file" too.

- The Open button now opens documents, photos, videos and other files in the external viewer under their real name, instead of a name like "tmpab12cd34", just as Save as already did.

- Settings > General > Notifications gains "Order of group messages in toast notifications:", with "Participant name first" (the default, as before: "Gustavo in WinZapp | Developers and Testers") and "Group name first" (as in the official WhatsApp Desktop: "WinZapp | Developers and Testers, Gustavo"). The choice changes only the text of toast notifications; what the screen reader announces while the window is active stays the same.

- Recording the computer's audio no longer stops with "audio device problem" when WinZapp stalls for a second or two (a busy or slow computer): the audio from that moment is skipped, the recording goes on, and the rest stays in sync.

- Neonize: with read receipts turned off in Privacy, you no longer see the "read" status of the messages you send in one-to-one chats, just as you no longer send read receipts to others (as with WPPConnect). The setting now works in both directions.

- ClickBus: verified business names now show in the conversation list, trip texts and interactive buttons are shown in full, and the option chosen in a carousel is sent with the card index.

- Settings > Storage gains Storage manager: inspect logical sizes and coverage, choose media matching and protections, preview local-copy removal or recoverable holding, restore held files, and configure optional rules, notices and advisory targets. Automatic removal is restricted to verified regenerable compile cache; all scheduling starts off. Cleaned media can be requested individually without clearing automatic-download blocks.

- Neonize calls: recover an answer or end that arrives before local call registration; group call failures now distinguish WhatsApp rate limiting and the supported member limits.

- Neonize calls: the log now records the relay endpoints and the relay's answers, to find why an incoming call may carry no audio from the other person (issue #689). No change in behavior.

- Neonize group calls: when a group member joins a group call you started, the call becomes active and the audio starts, instead of staying on "calling" with the microphone dropped. The end of the call is now recorded in the group and in your call history, not in a private chat with one of the members (issue #689).

- Neonize group calls: when an invitation to a group call arrives without the group's name, the program asks the server which group it is, so the call in progress shows in the group's conversation for you to join (issue #689).

- Neonize group calls: the log now records what the participant lists sent by the server hold (counts only, no names), to find why some people who join a call hear nobody (issue #689). No change in behavior.

- Neonize group calls: a device that is connected to the call now keeps the identifier it received when it joined, instead of losing it on the server's next update. Someone answering through Neonize no longer hears only the person who started the call and now hears the other participants too (issue #689).

- Neonize calls: calls you place, and calls you answer and hang up yourself, now appear in the conversation history and in the Calls section. They were not recorded at all before (issue #689).

- Neonize calls: the log now counts, every 5 seconds, the packets of each kind the relay delivers (no names), to find out why the caller's audio stops in some received calls (issue #689). No change in behavior.

- Group calls (Neonize): after you hang up a group call and go back into it from the calls panel (or join one that is already going on), you stopped hearing everyone. WinZapp was ignoring everyone who was already in the call before you came back; now it hears them again. The call log also counts repeated messages per call, so the diagnostic lines no longer vanish from a call after a few calls (issue #689).

- Neonize: the first message to a new phone number typed in a new conversation (Ctrl+N) no longer ends as "not confirmed" when WhatsApp has the number registered in its other form (with or without the 9th digit of Brazilian mobiles): it is now sent to the address WhatsApp knows. A number typed in a new conversation now opens the chat under the address WhatsApp knows, so no duplicate chat is left behind.

- Voice messages: the recording bitrate is back to 64 kbps, which sends quickly even past a minute (the change to 256 kbps had made sending slow). Settings > Audio gains "Voice message bitrate (kbps)", to choose from 32 to 256 kbps.
- Voice messages: recordings in stereo (AAC) now go out at 128 kbps by default, because 64 kbps made them sound poor; mono recordings stay at 64 kbps. Settings > Audio gains "Stereo voice message bitrate (kbps)". Installs still on the old 64 kbps default move to 128 kbps for stereo; any other rate you had chosen is kept.

- Settings > User Interface > Chats: new option "Number of new messages in the chat list", so the screen reader says the number of new messages before the chat name instead of after it. It applies to the chat list, the archived chats and the locked chats. (suggested by Michal Suchý)

- New Channels window (Alt+9, also in the navigation list): it shows the channels you follow or searches WhatsApp's channel directory (with no text, the recommended channels). For the chosen channel you can open it and read its updates, follow or unfollow it, mute or unmute its notifications, copy its link and, for your own channels, edit or delete it. You can also follow a channel from its link and create a channel. Showing channels in the conversation list is still a separate setting. Works with WPPConnect and Neonize.
- Channels, as on WhatsApp Web: in "Find channels", Category (business, entertainment, lifestyle, news, organizations, people, sports) and View (recommended, trending, popular, new) narrow the directory. In the channels you administer, the message field opens to post text updates, photos, videos and polls, your own can be edited from the message menu (Alt+E) within WhatsApp's edit window, an update can be pinned or unpinned from the message menu (Ctrl+Shift+P) and the pinned ones show in "Pinned messages"; the "Admins and followers..." button says how many admins the channel has and, for its owner, invites a contact to be an admin or cancels the invite. Works with WPPConnect and Neonize. That window lists the owner, the admins, the pending invites and the followers: the owner can make a follower an admin, cancel an invite, remove an admin or make an admin the owner, and an admin can stop being one.

- Calls: you can now add people to the call in progress, with the "Add participants" button in the call's participant list. A group call offers the group's members who are not in it yet; a private call offers your contacts, and the call then has several people, as on WhatsApp. Someone already called who has not joined is rung again. Works with WPPConnect and Neonize.

- The experimental Neonize engine was updated from 0.6.0 to 0.12.4. A chat deleted on the phone now disappears from WinZapp too, and marking a chat as read or unread on the phone updates the unread counter again. A contact's about now updates as soon as they change it.
- Neonize: reactions given in community announcement groups, which arrive encrypted, now show up, and yours are sent encrypted in those groups. Comments on announcements are now opened and sent by the engine itself, with the previous method as a fallback.

- WPPConnect Server updated to 2.10.78, which stops serving the private media cache over HTTP.

- WPPConnect Server updated to 2.10.75, which fixes a Chatwoot webhook that accepted requests without authentication and patches a vulnerability in the glob and minimatch libraries.

- WhatsApp settings > Privacy: new "Keep chats archived" option, WhatsApp's own, which decides whether an archived chat goes back to the list when a new message arrives. Works with WPPConnect and Neonize.

- Neonize: with WhatsApp's "Keep chats archived" option off, an archived chat that gets a new message now goes back to the chat list, as on the phone; before, it stayed under Archived.

- Voice messages: in Automatic, a recording whose left or right input is completely silent now goes out in mono, from the input with sound, so you are heard on both sides instead of only one. Mono and Stereo do exactly what they say.

- Settings (Ctrl+,) now opens at once: only the General page is built when the window opens, and every other page or window is built the first time you go to it. Search works straight away: results keep arriving while the other pages load, you can keep typing, and the screen reader is not interrupted when the results list grows.

- Neonize: reading a chat now marks it as read on the phone and on WhatsApp Web the way WhatsApp's own apps do. Before, after many chats read on Neonize, WhatsApp Web could keep showing messages you had already read as unread for several minutes.

- Neonize: messages in private chats are no longer marked as read by themselves while the conversation is not open.

- Neonize: channels in the chat list (when the option to show them is on) now show their name instead of a code.

- Neonize: sending to large groups is faster: the group's encryption key now goes only to the devices that do not have it yet, instead of to every member's device with every message.

- Neonize: messages to Meta AI work. WinZapp asks you to accept Meta AI's terms when the account has not accepted them yet, and Meta AI's replies are shown as text instead of an unknown message.

- Neonize: posting a status (text, image, video or voice) no longer fails with "server returned error 400". It happened in disappearing-message chats and, on any account, after the phone synced a contact saved under WhatsApp's new identifier.

- Neonize: WinZapp now asks the phone for a chat's older messages, as WhatsApp Web does when you click to see earlier messages. Before, a chat only had what came when the device was linked, and resyncing brought nothing more.

- A message WinZapp already knows no longer turns into "Waiting for this message". After switching from Neonize to WPPConnect, a message you had just sent could show that way, even after F5 or reopening WinZapp.

- Mentions: typing an emoji in the mention suggestion list no longer breaks the send. Before, the message could fail to go out with a server error.

- Groups: in a group where only admins can send messages, the message field is now read-only for members on Neonize too; before, it stayed editable in most of these groups.

- Keyboard shortcuts: the F1 list corrects action labels, removes repeated lines within a section, and separates mention suggestions while typing from mentions inside a message. In Spanish and European Portuguese, Alt+P focuses the message field, leaving Alt+E for editing messages.

- Voice messages: Settings > Audio now offers Automatic, Mono and Stereo recording. Mono mixes both microphone inputs so a microphone connected only on the left or right is heard from both sides. There is still one record button; the choice applies from the next recording.

- Fixed: the WPPConnect server no longer fails to start with "Cannot find module '@babel/runtime'" ("WinZapp API failed to start in time") after an update or fresh install.

- Neonize: if the internet drops in the middle of a call, you can still hang up; before, the button failed with a "Disconnected" error.

- WPPConnect Server 2.10.74 is now offered as an update without waiting for a new WinZapp version. It only updates documentation and a security dependency, and WinZapp's changes to the server are not affected.

- Neonize: a file or message you forward now appears in the destination conversation right away, without having to refresh it manually.

- Mac: checking for updates no longer fails with a secure connection error on Macs without python.org Python. Versions already installed need one manual install to get this fix.

- Groups: when someone is typing, WinZapp now announces their name instead of just their phone number when you have seen a message from them, even if they are not in your contacts.

- Mac: you can now record the microphone together with computer audio (Command+Shift+H) on macOS 14.4 and later. The first time, macOS asks for permission to record system audio.

- Groups: WinZapp now recognizes you in groups that list you by your linked ID (@lid), so an admin no longer finds Add Member dimmed.

- Neonize calls: a call you place that nobody answers now ends by itself after a minute, with the "not answered" outcome, instead of ringing in the call window for minutes after WhatsApp stopped ringing the other phone.
- Mac: WinZapp now says when macOS is waiting for microphone permission or when it was denied, instead of the record button seeming to do nothing.

- Voice messages: there is now a single record button. WinZapp records in stereo when the input device offers two channels and in mono otherwise, so the second record button, Ctrl+Shift+G and the stereo option are gone. A stereo recording is now a real voice message that plays on iPhone, and quality is up to 256 kbps. An attached stereo Opus file is now converted so it plays on iPhone too.

- Attached contacts: a received contact no longer arrives empty and without a phone number. The contact card is now kept by both WPPConnect and Neonize, so you can see and copy the number and chat with the person.

- Neonize: posts from channels you follow (ids starting with 120363) no longer show up as chats and messages; they were never meant to appear outside the channels area.

- Pairing: fixed the app staying on the pairing screen after a successful link, while the phone already listed it as connected.

- Neonize calls: added a disabled-by-default experimental 48 kHz PCM path for negotiated Opus calls, with format and call-instance checks. Normal calls retain the existing MLow fallback.

- Marking read or unread, muting, archiving and pinning now have spoken confirmation. A repeated error fetching the chat list shows one box instead of one per attempt. On the Mac, WinZapp notices when the computer wakes and reconnects, and Home and End go to the start and end of lists. When a session cannot be resumed, pairing the same number again no longer deletes your history.

- The README now starts with direct download links for Windows and Mac, so you no longer have to search the Releases page for the right file.

- Arabic: voice message and audio transcription now uses "تفريغ" (transcription) instead of "تسجيل" (recording) in menus, settings and messages, so it no longer sounds like recording your voice.

- When you accept an update, WinZapp now checks again which version is the latest before downloading, so it no longer installs an alpha older than the newest when alphas are published in quick succession.

- Neonize calls: fixed a race that could leave an answered incoming call silent, preserved multi-frame received audio and reduced microphone aliasing. The negotiated codec is now used for audio, with bounded packet reordering and loss handling.

- WPPConnect Server updated to 2.10.71, which adds a fix for a vulnerability in a library the browser layer uses (deepmerge) and loads it when the server starts.

- Quick chats: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F1–F10 assigns a chat, and Ctrl+Shift+the same function key opens it from anywhere in the window (F10 is slot 0). Assignments are per account, shortcuts can be changed in Settings, and existing bookmark shortcuts remain available.

- Arabic is now available in Settings > General > Language, with Arabic text in the Windows installer and uninstaller.

- WPPConnect Server updated to 2.10.70, which tightens its admin routes (listing and backing up sessions now need the secret key in a header instead of the address), the session folders it deletes on logout and the way contact lists are split. The existing session cleanup on shutdown with a custom API was adjusted to match.

- A group call that rang and was not answered is now recorded in its group, and its ring names the group: it no longer appears as a private call from whoever started it.

- New connection engine, experimental: Neonize connects to WhatsApp without a browser, through a local bridge. Choose it in Settings, Connection (or in the question on the first launch) and restart WinZapp; WPPConnect remains the default. Compiled builds already include the bridge and keep WPPConnect installed alongside it; from a repository checkout, set the bridge up with neonize_bridge/prepare.py (see the README in that folder). On the first launch after updating, an install still on WPPConnect gets a one-time notice offering the switch; each engine keeps its own connection, so switching and coming back does not lose either. With Neonize, custom chat lists, joining a community's groups (or asking to) and cancelling that request, deactivating a community, editing and deleting your channels, choosing who sees your status and removing a contact also work. Catalogs, carts and orders also work with Neonize (viewing a business's catalog, filling and sending a cart, and, on a Business account, answering orders and managing your own catalog), as do buttons, lists and Pix keys in messages. Forwarding locations and contact cards works with Neonize too. Video calls, turning a voice call into a video call and group calls also work with Neonize. A community also lists, with Neonize, the groups you are not in. Ongoing group calls can also be found and joined with Neonize, with the list of who is in them. Call buttons in chats, including joining an ongoing group call, follow the support reported by Neonize and refresh automatically when its reply arrives, without taking focus from another window or a hidden chat. Public profile names received during contact synchronization are also used for group participants without a private chat, while saved address-book names keep priority.

- Use the Call participants button in the call window, or on a selected ongoing call in Calls, to see the connected people by name.

- Mistral is available for online transcription, image descriptions and PDF text extraction. Audio uses the voice message model chosen in the provider window (Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3 by default, or Voxtral Small Transcribe 3; both in preview); photos, stickers and video frames use the selected vision model (Ministral 3 3B by default); PDFs use Mistral OCR. Get models lists only compatible vision models. Before media is sent to Mistral, WinZapp warns that its free plan may use requests for training.

- While a call is available, group chats show "Join ongoing voice call" or "Join ongoing video call (camera off)" instead of the start-call buttons. Calls lists ongoing calls in All and Ongoing, including multiparty calls outside group chats. Video joins start with the camera off.

- Many contact presence updates in a row (typing, online) no longer freeze WinZapp for seconds or slow the whole computer down on accounts with many chats.
- Contact presence: learning new contact names no longer waits for a database write in the interface. Pending name updates keep the latest full snapshot, with ordered handling during shutdown and local data clearing.

- Contact presence: reduced repeated interface work when many online or typing updates arrive. Unchanged window titles and archived-chat labels are no longer rewritten, while typing announcements keep their existing timing.

- Chat lists (conversations, archived and locked chats) now use the full width of the list, so chat names and message previews are cut off much less when the window is wide.

- Updating WinZapp or WPPConnect no longer freezes the whole computer half-way through. The installation and build steps now run at lower priority, so the screen reader keeps speaking smoothly.

- WPPConnect Server updated to 2.10.63, with WPPConnect 2.3.6 and WA-JS 4.7.2. The browser WinZapp drives is now released more completely when a session closes or fails to start, a restored session is recognised as logged in sooner, and a phone disconnection is reported only after a real unpair.

- Typing and voice-recording indicators in private chats remain available when WhatsApp reports the contact as offline. Activity is shown separately from online visibility and expires when it stops being refreshed. Activity belongs to the conversation where it occurs: groups and private chats are tracked separately. Missed last-seen refreshes are retried, and visibility restrictions also clear previously displayed online and last-seen information. If status data keeps waiting to become ready in an open chat, WinZapp makes a limited number of recovery attempts; hidden information does not trigger them. When status data is not yet ready, the first read waits for the subscription to finish; last-seen and visibility changes also update independently of activity changes. A single stalled status request no longer blocks later refreshes; replacement reads remain limited. Missing last-seen information is refreshed when returning to the window, while reading the current contact's information, and when typing or recording ends without a final update. Contact information opens without waiting for last-seen requests; late profile presence replies cannot restore information from a previous connection. Group typing and recording indicators no longer stay tied to an old connection. Visibility restrictions discovered during a status refresh also clear old information in chats and contact details.

- Pinned messages: opening the pinned messages of a group whose pins are older than what WhatsApp Web keeps in memory no longer fails with "Could not load pinned messages", and the count on the button shows the right number.

- WPPConnect Server updated to 2.10.62. Pairing a new account no longer loses the QR code when WhatsApp reports the phone as disconnected a moment after the session starts.

- Calls: reinstalling WPPConnect preserves a newer compatible WhatsApp Web catalogue and checks its freshness. A rebuilt catalogue is checked without the previous six-hour wait. A confirmed non-retryable VoIP contract mismatch stops repeated initialization.

- Group calls: a group with more than 32 participants cannot be called on WhatsApp, so the call buttons are replaced by a "Calling is not possible" button whose note says the group has more than 32 participants, and the call shortcuts say the same instead of starting a call.

- Group calls: the voice and video call buttons now appear in a group conversation and start a call to the group, and an incoming group call rings, is announced by the group's name and can be answered, with the same Answer button and global answer key as a one-to-one call. Turning the camera on during a voice call works as it does in a one-to-one call, and call events from each participant stay with the group, so the call window keeps the group's name from the first ring to the end.

- Video calls: WinZapp now finds the camera with the FFmpeg build it ships, which lists DirectShow devices without the "DirectShow video devices" heading. That build returned no camera at all, so a video call went out receive-only, with "No camera found" in the log.

- Buttons in business messages can be answered: a reply button sends the answer the way WhatsApp Web does (reply buttons of plain messages, quick replies of interactive messages, template buttons and the rows of lists), a link button opens the link, a copy button copies the code and a call button says the number. The buttons appear under the message list when the message is selected.

- WPPConnect Server 2.10.61 is now offered as an update without waiting for a new WinZapp version. It only updates dependencies, and WinZapp's changes to the server are not affected.

- WPPConnect Server 2.10.63 is now offered as an update without waiting for a new WinZapp version. It only updates dependencies, and WinZapp's changes to the server are not affected.

- macOS updates explain whether verification failed because of a connection, certificate, server or GitHub request-limit problem, and whether the verification file or the official release tag could not be checked. Temporary connection and server failures get one retry; request limits show a wait time and do not trigger repeated requests during that wait.

- Updates: installation keeps ownership after WinZapp closes, and a downloaded package waiting to install is kept. Only a complete copy counts as success; a successful update clears an earlier failure warning. Automatic reopening waits for the installer to finish and does not proceed when its wait limit is reached. After an incomplete or unconfirmed copy, WinZapp stays closed and opens recovery instructions in Notepad.

- Voice calls preserve timing across audio packets and use band-limited conversion when the microphone or speaker needs a different sample rate. Audio already at the call rate keeps the direct path.

- The Settings window now has a search field and a list of categories: the arrow keys change category, Tab enters its options and, in the search, the down arrow goes to the results, where Enter or Space opens the option found, even when it is in the window of a button. Several categories were merged: Audio (devices, audio pasted with Ctrl+V, voice messages and silencing while recording), Event sounds (sound events and alert tones) and Storage (with the save folder). Spoken content, Audio playback, Profile backup, Keyboard shortcuts, Reactions, Notifications, Messages, Chats, Locked chats and Confirmations became buttons that open the window of each subject. "User Interface" is now called "Interface", and Connection moved to the end of the list.

- WhatsApp settings (File menu) now opens Settings already on the WhatsApp settings category, with the Privacy and Profile buttons; the separate window is gone. WinZapp only asks WhatsApp when you open each button, and Ctrl+Shift+, still opens that category.

- Communities: the "New chat" window has the new "Communities" button, which opens the list of the communities you are in. Choosing a community shows its description, its admins and the groups of it you have joined, with the announcement group and the general group identified; Enter or "Open group" goes to the selected group. If you are an admin of the community, the window also offers "Add groups", "Remove group from the community", "Promote to community admin", "Demote community admin" and "Deactivate community", and "New community" creates a community with a name, a description and the groups you choose. After each action WinZapp reads the communities again and only says it is done when WhatsApp shows the change; otherwise it says the request was sent but is not confirmed yet, or that it was refused.

- Community announcement replies: open a message menu and choose "Community announcement replies" to read and send replies. Replies update by themselves while the window is open, the reply field is no longer read-only, and your text is kept when sending is not confirmed. In the chat list, the group's preview says "So-and-so replied to an announcement" when that is the latest activity. Announcements report the known reply count. Authors use saved or profile names, and your replies respect your self-reference setting.

- Communities is now a row of the navigation list, after Calls, with its Alt+8 shortcut in the row's name, so it can be reached by arrowing through the list as well as with Alt+8.
